description: Get a prioritized market signal brief for an industry vertical, built from signals you supply. Included with the SignalDesk plan ($24/mo or $240/yr). Does not charge per use: returns the plan prices and the subscribe link.

signals.description: Optional raw signals (news, posts, notes) to brief from, up to 6000 characters. Without it, the brief is written from general knowledge of the vertical.
